practice.message: It is not one of the three artifacts of the 2020 Scrum Guide — the Product Backlog, the Sprint Backlog and the Increment — so Scrumooth labels it a complementary practice. It is still enforced as the team's own agreement: a Sprint Backlog cannot be committed, and a Sprint cannot start, while a selected item has an unverified criterion. Team members record the verifications; the Scrum Master maintains the agreement.
